title: Several 'barrow' side-dungeons in different regions (the Opened Cairn on Highward's moor, the Cutter's Barrow in Thornwold) and both watch-towers (Highward's Old Watchtower stair, Thornwold's Long Watch stair) are verbatim copy-paste content: identical wight fight, identical 'small worn ring' reward in an identical alcove line, identical shade-on-the-stair riddle, identical 'a cracked spyglass' reward at the top. Noticeable once you've done it twice.
